name: hmi_create_text_list
description: Create a new text list on a WinCC Unified device with specified entries and values/ranges.

device_name.description: Target HMI device or software name (optional).

entries.description: List of text entries. Each entry: { value, from_value (optional), to_value (optional), text, multilingual_texts (optional dict of lang->text) }.

list_name.description: Name of the text list to create.
